label: Perfect love in the hiddenness challenge: Sig.PerfectLove w means a perfectly loving God exists at w
term: perfect love in the hiddenness challenge
definition: Sig.PerfectLove w means a perfectly loving God exists at w. Love seeks the good and personal relationship of capable creatures; whether that entails immediate conscious access at every capable time is not part of the predicate definition. GodLoves, AlwaysOpen and QualifiedOpen are distinct open normative readings.
